result.title: Time Flies When You Parallelise: Pareto-efficient Time Series Foundation Models with Linear Recurrences
result.summary: Time series foundation models have demonstrated strong zero-shot forecasting performance, but computational efficiency remains a central architectural challenge. Temporal self-attention incurs quadratic cost in the number of temporal tokens, while nonlinear recurrent state transitions restrict parallel computation along the temporal dimension. We introduce ci-proto, a family of time series foundation models based on Mamba-3, whose linear state recurrences support chunk-wise parallel-in-time computation during training, and inference costs that scale linearly with sequence length. The architecture alternates recurrent temporal processing with cross-variate attention, supporting multivariate probabilistic forecasting with past-only and future-known covariates. Across fev-bench's 100 forecasting tasks, ci-proto XL sets a new state of the art among time series foundation models. The five ci-proto variants also make up the entire Pareto frontier for mean scaled quantile loss and mean absolute scaled error against both parameter count and median runtime.

AI.brief_summary: 提出基于 Mamba-3 的时间序列基础模型族 ci-proto，交替使用线性状态递推做时序处理、并用跨变量注意力支持多变量概率预测；训练时以 chunk 方式在时间维并行计算，推理成本随序列长度线性增长，在 fev-bench 的 100 个任务上取得最优结果并占据精度—成本 Pareto 前沿。
